params.body:
Builds on #6 (shares `astro.config.ts` and `src/pages/index.astro`); merge #6 first.

A pass over the SEO basics of the built site. Titles, descriptions, `lang`, Open Graph and Twitter tags, one `h1` per page, image alt texts and robots.txt were already in place. Four things were not.

## Canonical pointed at the Netlify address

thoekske.com serves the site, but `PUBLIC_SITE_URL` is not set on Netlify, so the canonical link, `og:url`, the sitemap and robots.txt all named `cafe-t-hoekske.netlify.app`. Search engines were told the Netlify address is the real one. The fallback in `astro.config.ts` is now `https://thoekske.com`; `PUBLIC_SITE_URL` still overrides it.

## Opening hours in the BarOrPub JSON-LD

The hours went out as typed in the Studio ("10.30", "24.00"); schema.org expects `HH:MM`. `schemaTime()` turns them into "10:30", and a midnight closing into "23:59". A late closing ("2.00") becomes "02:00".

## Event JSON-LD

Event pages now carry a schema.org `Event` (name, description, start and end, scheduled, offline, the café as place and organizer, the drawing as image), so a search result can show the date. `Layout` takes an optional `schema` prop for page-level JSON-LD.

## Smaller

- Home meta description, used when the homepage has no lede: "Café 't Hoekske, op de hoek van het Polenplein in Ardooie. Openingsuren, agenda en contact." (with "de kaart" once the menu is switched on). It read "Openingsuren, agenda." after #6.
- A `404` page in the site's style with links home and to the agenda, `noindex`, instead of Netlify's plain "Page not found". `Layout` takes `noindex`, which swaps the canonical link for a robots meta.

## Checked

- `astro build` against the live dataset (read only) and `tsc --noEmit`, both clean.
- Built output: canonical, robots.txt and sitemap on thoekske.com; hours JSON-LD in `HH:MM`; Event JSON-LD on the event page; 404 with `noindex` and not in the sitemap.

No content was written to Sanity.
params.title: SEO basics: thoekske.com as canonical, valid JSON-LD, 404 page
